summary.en:
- [[character:rmc]] is a general support, providing CRIT Rate and True DMG to a target ally.
- [[character:rmc]]'s Memosprite Mem gains charge when allies gain energy, with 10 Energy from allies granting Mem 1% Charge. At 100% Charge, Mem can grant advance the action of 1 ally by 100%, granting a True DMG and CRIT Rate buff. Mem also constantly gives the entire team a CRIT DMG boost.
- The True DMG given by Mem increases when the target ally has more Max Energy, up to 200 Max Energy. For units that do not use Energy, [[character:rmc]]'s E4 allows Mem to gain 3% Charge from their action while also giving an increase in True DMG buff.

details.en: - E1 increases CRIT Rate of a selected ally target by 10% when Mem's Charge reaches 100%.
